news.title: Tatum scores 41 to help Celtics snap 4-game skid with a 131-116 win over Wizards
news.text: — Jayson Tatum scored 28 of his 41 points in the first half and the Boston Celtics snapped their four-game losing streak by beating the Washington Wizards 131-116 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Brandin Podziemski scores 18 points as Warriors hold of Celtics 88-87 to snap five-game losing skid
news.text: — Brandin Podziemski had 18 points and seven rebounds and the Golden State Warriors snapped a five-game losing streak by holding off Boston for an 88-87 win Sunday night, sending the Celtics to their first four-game skid in five years.

news.title: Murray's putback with 5 seconds left lifts Kings to 97-96 win over Celtics, ending 8-game skid
news.text: — Keegan Murray's putback over three defenders with 5 seconds left lifted the Sacramento Kings to a 97-96 victory over the Boston Celtics on Saturday night.

news.title: Jokic scores 24, Murray adds 21; Nuggets rally from 17-point deficit to beat Celtics 105-101
news.text: — Nikola Jokic had 24 points, nine assists and eight rebounds, Jamal Murray had 21 points, seven rebounds and four steals, and the Denver Nuggets overcame a 17-point first-half deficit to defeat the Boston Celtics 105-101 on Wednesday night.

news.title: Bane scores 24, Magic rally in 4th quarter to beat Celtics 115-105, extend win streak to 4 games
news.text: — Desmond Bane had 24 points and eight rebounds to help the Orlando Magic rally in the fourth quarter and earn their fourth consecutive victory, 115-105 over the Boston Celtics on Monday night.

news.title: Tatum scores 32, Celtics set franchise history on the way to 131-94 rout of Mavericks
news.text: — Jayson Tatum scored 32 points in 30 minutes on a night the Boston Celtics set a franchise record for its lead at the end of the opening period on the way to a 131-94 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday night.

news.title: Celtics set franchise mark with 42-9 lead over Mavericks after one quarter
news.text: The Celtics led the Mavericks 42-9 at the end of the first quarter Sunday, the largest scoring margin in a quarter since 1987.

news.title: Celtics win 5th straight, overcoming 22-point deficit to beat Raptors 98-93
news.text: — Jayson Tatum made the tying and go-ahead free throws with 25.2 seconds remaining and the Boston Celtics overcame a 22-point deficit to beat the Toronto Raptors 98-93 on Wednesday night, extending their winning streak to five.
